correctness.rationale: The universal root accesses every material counterexample: if an implication fails at any world it fails at the root. Retaining the root and at most one global counterexample per root-false syntactic implication, and replacing nonroot implication rows by empty or singleton rows depending on original truth, yields a simultaneous structural induction preserving all chosen subformulas at every retained world. Closed formulas are valuation-independent, so frame validation of fixed closed negative X transfers. Model size/relations are polynomial in input length; the dual-rail 3-SAT reduction uses root reflexivity to exclude inconsistent literal pairs, proving NP hardness for designated-root semantic satisfiability. The actual verify_fmt.py source was read; its reported random checks are not an infinite-model proof.
